channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio: Expressei a Trump 'diferença gritante' que haverá entre governo Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, said he told U.S. President Donald Trump about the 'glaring difference' between a potential Bolsonaro government and the current Lula administration. The statement was made on Tuesday, the 26th, as part of his political positioning in the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Valdemar diz que fala sobre Flávio buscar dinheiro com Vorcaro em visita foi tirada de contexto
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that his comment regarding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master was taken out of context. He said the remark was decontextualized and did not reflect its original intent.

item.title: Estrategista digital de Bolsonaro deixa pré-campanha de Flávio
item.description: Digital strategist Marcos Aurélio Carvalho, a key figure in Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 presidential campaign, departed Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign digital team after completing the initial phase of diagnosis, positioning, and strategic organization. His exit marks the third departure from the candidate’s communications team since the audio leak in which the senator asked for money from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. The campaign, now under the political leadership of Rogério Marinho, has restructured with Eduardo Fischer taking over strategy and Alexandre Oltramari leading marketing efforts.

item.title: Caso Master: O avanço entre governo Lula e DF para tentar salvar o BRB
item.description: The Lula government and the Federal District have advanced in an agreement to resolve BRB's financial crisis, involving a loan to the Operations Guarantor Fund guaranteed by private banks, with the DF offering its monthly federal transfers as collateral. The Union will adjust the DF's debt ceiling under the PRAF, while STF Minister Luiz Fux must still validate the terms at a conciliation hearing set for May 28. BRB faces a R$6.6 billion debt due to fraudulent transactions with Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio diz que pediu a Trump que classifique PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, met with Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026, to urge the U.S. to designate Brazil's PCC and CV criminal factions as terrorist organizations. He stated he made the explicit request, while the Lula government opposes the move, citing risks of foreign interference. The meeting, not listed in Trump's official schedule, included his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo.

item.title: Flávio acusa Itamaraty de agir como “extensão partidária do PT”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Itamaraty of acting as a partisan extension of the PT after the Brazilian embassy in Washington denied him support to speak with the press following his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House. The criticism was issued by his team on Tuesday, the 26th.

item.title: Após pedido de Flávio a Trump, entenda por que governo não quer que as facções sejam classificadas como terroristas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with Donald Trump at the White House and urged him to designate the PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations. The Brazilian government, represented by Lula, did not raise the issue in its meeting with Trump and has resisted the classification, fearing damage to bilateral relations and domestic crime-fighting strategies. The proposal had been under consideration by the Trump administration since 2025, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio advocating for including Brazilian factions on the terrorist list, although Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira attempted to dissuade him.

item.title: ‘Muitas questões que precisa explicar’, diz Tarcísio sobre relação de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said Senator Flávio Bolsonaro must explain his ties to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, linked to the Master Bank scandal and the funding of the Dark Horse film honoring Jair Bolsonaro. He stated that society is on alert and that full clarification is needed, denying any distancing between himself and Flávio after the audio leak by The Intercept Brasil. Tarcísio confirmed he will attend the March for Jesus in June but does not know if Flávio will attend, emphasizing he will only focus on elections during the campaign period.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio Bolsonaro precisa explicar relação com Vorcaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro still needs to clarify his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is under investigation for fraud at Banco Master, particularly regarding the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. Despite the criticism, Tarcísio denied any political distancing and confirmed Flávio remains an ally, noting that his recent trip to the U.S. to meet with Donald Trump is natural for someone positioning himself as a presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido a Trump que classifique PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claims he requested U.S. President Donald Trump to designate the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations during a meeting at the White House. He contrasted his stance with the Lula government, which he says urges the U.S. not to make such a designation. The meeting took place amid declining poll numbers following allegations that Flávio sought funding from a banker for a film about his father.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido para Donald Trump classificar PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he asked Donald Trump to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations during a meeting in Washington. He criticized Lula for seeking to avoid such a designation and expressed interest in forming international agreements to combat Brazilian criminal factions. The U.S. government has been analyzing for over a year whether to label groups like PCC and CV as terrorists, having already done so with Mexican cartels and Venezuela’s Tren de Aragua.

item.title: Tarcísio cobra explicações de Flávio sobre caso Vorcaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) publicly demanded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-SP) clarify his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master. The statement was made during an event in Perus, West Zone of São Paulo, in response to questions about the Vorcaro case, which involves allegations of financial irregularities and political influence.

item.title: Motta diz que falou com Frias, mas nega ter autorizado missão
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta said he spoke with Deputy Mário Frias while he was in the U.S. but denied authorizing his international mission. Motta stated Frias has returned to Brazil and is ready to clarify matters before the STF regarding amendments linked to the 'Dark Horse' film. The Chamber confirmed Frias traveled without prior authorization, as ordered by Minister Flávio Dino.

item.title: Zema não descarta aliança com Caiado, mas diz que composição poderá ser decidida na 'data-limite'
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) said he does not rule out an alliance with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) to form a right-wing alternative candidacy to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), but noted that the final composition will be decided close to the August 15 candidate registration deadline. He praised his relationship with Caiado, calling Goiás and Minas 'almost twin states,' and jokingly suggested the ticket could be reversed. Zema also reaffirmed he will continue his campaign despite growing rifts with Bolsonarismo following his criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged ties to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio pede a Trump que PCC e CV sejam tratados como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he asked U.S. President Donald Trump to designate the PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations. He claimed these groups control entire territories in Brazil and pose a national security threat. The request was made during a meeting in the Oval Office.

item.title: Análise: Foto de Flávio Bolsonaro com Trump lembra mais encontro de fã com ídolo do que de pré-candidato com presidente
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to the U.S. amid allegations regarding the Banco Master scandal, avoiding questions about an alleged contract to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. His meeting with Donald Trump was framed as a pre-candidacy engagement, but his demeanor and context suggest more of a fan-meeting-idol moment than a diplomatic agenda. His silence on the Master case is seen as more consequential for his campaign than the photo with the U.S. president.

item.title: Em fase bolsonarista, presidente da Alesp é primeiro a comentar foto de Flávio com Trump
item.description: The president of the São Paulo Legislative Assembly (Alesp) and Senate candidate for the PL, André do Prado, was the first to like and respond with clapping hands to the photo posted by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) alongside Donald Trump, published on Tuesday (26). The interaction reflects the bolsonarist alignment between the politicians and symbolic support for the former U.S. president.

item.title: ‘Tem muitas questões que ele mesmo precisa explicar’, diz Tarcísio sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said Flávio Bolsonaro has "many questions" to answer regarding his ties to Daniel Vorcaro and the Dark Horse film financing linked to Banco Master. He denied that the lack of public engagements with the senator stems from the scandal’s fallout, stating he is focused on governing the state.

item.title: Articulação de Motta e aval de Lula reduzem espaço para reação ao fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced a deal to reduce the workweek by two hours with a one-year transition period for ending the 6×1 scale, negotiated with the Lula government. Though slower than the Planalto wanted and faster than Congress and business sectors expected, the agreement is expected to advance due to 68% public support (Quaest poll) and electoral risks of opposing it in an election year. Motta is positioning the PEC as a hallmark of his leadership, bolstered by recent wins like Odair Cunha’s TCU election, showing his growing ability to align with the federal government.

item.title: Senado aprova MP que reajusta salário de professores
item.description: The Senate approved a provisional measure raising the minimum salary for basic education teachers by 5.4% in 2026, increasing the floor from R$4,867.77 to R$5,130.63. The initiative, proposed by President Lula and adjusted by rapporteur Senator Professora Dorinha (União-TO), extends benefits to temporary teachers and ties future adjustments to the prior year’s INPC plus 50% of the real revenue variation of Fundeb over the past five years, ensuring a real gain of 1.5 percentage points above 2025’s inflation (3.9%).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que pediu a Trump para classificar PCC e CV como grupos terroristas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), senator and pre-candidate for President, stated in a press briefing after meeting with Donald Trump at the White House that he urged the U.S. president to designate PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations. Trump said he would review the request. Flávio also said he pledged to bring Brazil into the 'Americas Shield' coalition if elected, and discussed public security, tariffs, rare earths, and the situation of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que pediu a Trump para declarar PCC e CV como terroristas e afirma que campanha tem 'altos e baixos’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House represents international recognition of his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy, dismissing any campaign crisis despite the Vorcaro affair. He urged the U.S. to designate PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations, arguing their actions resemble those of international terrorist groups. He also discussed strategic investments, rare earths, and the need to avoid new trade tariffs on Brazilian exports if elected.

item.title: Lei reconhece Expo Cordeiro (RJ) como manifestação da cultura nacional
item.description: The Expo Cordeiro in Rio de Janeiro was recognized as a national cultural manifestation by Law 15.417/26, signed by President Lula. Held since 1921, it is the country's oldest agricultural exhibition and was already declared State Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2021, driving tourism, local economy, and regional culture.

item.title: Soraya Thronicke declara apoio à reeleição de Lula e diz que presidente a deixou 'de queixo caído'
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke declared her support for the re-election of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during an event in Anastácio (MS), saying she was left 'jaw-dropped' by his humanity and conduct. She justified her shift based on her experience in parliamentary inquiries, stating that Lula’s government representatives always attended while Bolsonaro’s allies never did, calling it a 'disgrace'.

item.title: Flávio posta foto ao lado de Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House in Washington on Tuesday, May 26, 2026. The meeting was arranged by Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, and Flávio plans to remain in the capital until Wednesday, May 27, with additional meetings scheduled with senior State Department officials.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é recebido por Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, was received by U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on Tuesday, May 26. Bolsonaro shared a photo of the meeting on his X account.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem encontro com Donald Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was received by U.S. President Donald Trump in the Oval Office of the White House on Tuesday, March 26. The meeting took place amid what is described as the worst crisis of his pre-campaign, though specific agenda details were not disclosed. The encounter highlights the alignment between the Bolsonaro clan and international conservative figures.

item.title: Flávio conseguiu a foto ao lado de Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, met with U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington on Tuesday, the 26th. The meeting, previously shrouded in uncertainty and not officially confirmed by allies, was described as strategic for his pre-campaign. The photo alongside Trump was published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio Bolsonaro precisa explicar visita a Vorcaro e deseja sucesso na viagem do pré-candidato aos EUA
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said Senator Flávio Bolsonaro must explain his ties to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, amid allegations of financial fraud linked to the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. While demanding accountability, Tarcísio denied any political rift and wished Flávio success on his upcoming trip to the United States, where he plans to meet with former President Donald Trump.

item.title: Lula defende escala 5 X 2 e cita dupla jornada feminina
item.description: President Lula advocated ending the 6x1 work schedule and adopting a 5x2 model, emphasizing the disproportionate burden of women's double shift between employment and domestic chores. The proposal seeks to reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary reduction, with up to 14 months for implementation after PEC promulgation. The government has secured congressional agreement, and the measure is expected to be voted in the special committee and proceed to the Chamber plenary on May 28.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro encontra Donald Trump na Casa Branca e publica foto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on March 26, after receiving an invitation from the Trump administration through Secretary of State Marco Rubio and coordination by Eduardo Bolsonaro. The meeting, which was not on Trump’s official schedule, came as Flávio seeks to improve his public image following the release of audio recordings in which he asked banker Daniel Vorcaro for funds to finance a biopic of his father, Jair Bolsonaro. His team failed to secure a press briefing at the Brazilian Embassy in Washington and will instead deliver the statement at an alternative location.

item.title: Em busca de agenda positiva, Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House in a visit arranged by his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, aiming to shift focus from a campaign crisis triggered by revelations that Daniel Vorcaro financed a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The scandal, exposed by The Intercept, caused Flávio’s poll numbers to drop, while President Lula extended his lead in voter intention surveys.

item.title: Inac pede que ministros do STF sigam Cármen contra mudar Ficha Limpa
item.description: The Inac urged STF ministers to follow Justice Cármen Lúcia’s vote opposing changes to the Clean Record Law approved by Congress in 2025, which reduced ineligibility periods for convicted politicians. The group argues the changes were enacted without public consultation and violate the Constitution, stressing that maintaining the law’s strictness is vital to prevent premature return of corrupt officials to public life. If the relator’s vote prevails, figures such as Eduardo Cunha, Anthony Garotinho, and José Roberto Arruda will remain barred from running in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Senado Federal eleva piso dos professores para R$5.130 em 2026 e muda cálculo para reajuste
item.description: The Federal Senate approved a provisional measure raising the national minimum wage for basic education teachers to R$5,130.63 in 2026, with a 5.40% increase effective in 2025. The new adjustment formula combines the INPC with 50% of the average real variation in Fundeb revenues over the last five years, ensuring a real gain of 1.50% above inflation. The text now proceeds to presidential sanction after approval by the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Motta nega atuar como ponte entre Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, stated he was not approached by either Lula or Alcolumbre to mediate dialogue between them, but advocated for resuming talks as being in the country's best interest. He noted his good relationship with both leaders and said he would help where possible, though the initiative depends solely on the parties involved. The rift between Lula and Alcolumbre worsened after the Senate rejected Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Court, Jorge Messias, in April.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com Trump na Casa Branca; reunião foi breve
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) had a brief meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026, during a visit coordinated by his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro. The meeting lasted only a few minutes and reportedly aimed to discuss labeling factions as terrorist organizations and protecting free speech on social media in Brazil, though it remains unclear if these topics were formally raised. The encounter comes amid declining poll numbers for Flávio in Datafolha surveys, while Lula maintains or extends his lead in both first and second-round scenarios.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Tem muitas questões que ele mesmo precisa explicar’
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Flávio Bolsonaro must explain his involvement with Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro, following revelations about negotiations for the 'Dark Horse' film sponsorship. As coordinator of Flávio’s campaign in São Paulo, Tarcísio avoided joint appearances after the scandal, citing his gubernatorial duties, and emphasized that the public deserves clarity on the case, which involves up to R$ 134 million.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O chá de cadeira de Trump e a rasteira de Valdemar em Flávio | Papo Antagonista
item.description: On Papo Antagonista, the possible meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and Donald Trump was discussed, along with Valdemar Costa Neto's statements regarding Flávio Bolsonaro's relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The program analyzed the political implications of these events for the Brazilian electoral landscape in 2026.

item.title: Kassio cria comissão com TREs para discutir regras para uso de IA na Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, created a commission with the TREs to discuss rules for the use of artificial intelligence in Electoral Justice. The initiative aims to establish guidelines to ensure transparency, security, and ethics in the application of AI in electoral processes.

item.title: Flávio posta vídeo e diz que está “entrando” na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video stating he is 'entering' the White House for a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump, following his arrival in Washington on Monday, May 25. The meeting, arranged by Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, is anticipated despite concerns from his team about possible cancellation, given Trump’s recent decision to skip his son’s wedding to focus on Iran negotiations.

item.title: As duas próximas pesquisas desta semana sobre a eleição presidencial
item.description: This week, two new presidential election 2026 intention-to-vote polls will be released: Ideia on Thursday (28) with 1,500 interviews and a 2.5-point margin of error, and PoderData on Friday (29) with 2,400 interviews and a two-point margin of error. A Nexus/BTG Pactual poll released on Monday (25) showed Lula (PT) ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential runoff with 47% to 43%, and Lula leading in the first round with 40% compared to Bolsonaro's 35%.

item.title: Presidente do PT se encontra com Josué Gomes para discutir candidatura em MG após ‘não’ de Pacheco
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva met with Josué Gomes (PSB), former president of Fiesp, to discuss Gomes' potential candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais after Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB) confirmed he will not run. The meeting took place in Brasília, four months before the 2026 election first round, as the PT seeks a competitive slate in Brazil's second-largest electoral college. Lula had previously expressed interest in Pacheco as a candidate, but Pacheco reiterated his intention to retire from public office after his term ends.

item.title: Raquel Lyra volta a citar apoio de Lula e dá recado a João Campos: “Pernambuco não tem dono”
item.description: Pernambuco Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) reiterated her support from President Lula and challenged her main rival João Campos (PSB), stating that 'Pernambuco has no owner,' referencing the PSB's long-standing political dominance. She emphasized federal partnerships for infrastructure projects and defended her administration as rooted in hard work, not electoral vanity, as she seeks to narrow Campos' lead in polls where she currently trails in second place.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Cláudio Castro já condecorou Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor and PL Senate pre-candidate Cláudio Castro was targeted in a Federal Police operation over suspected illicit ties with Daniel Vorcaro, controller of Banco Master, related to the R$ 3.7 billion in investments raised. Castro had previously awarded Senator Flávio Bolsonaro the Mérito Avante Bombeiro medal in 2020. Flávio also maintained close financial ties with Vorcaro, requesting funding for a film about Jair Bolsonaro and referring to him as 'brother'.

item.title: O novo julgamento no STF sobre multa de R$ 452 mil para Roberto Jefferson
item.description: The STF will rule from June 5 on a petition by Roberto Jefferson challenging a R$452,300 fine imposed by Justice Alexandre de Moraes in 2024, linked to his conviction for inciting crimes, undermining the Powers, defamation, and homophobia. The PGR recommended rejecting the appeal, and the virtual plenary vote will run until June 15, unless a justice requests more time or an in-person session. Although his sentence was reduced in January 2026, Jefferson seeks to avoid payment, even in installments, claiming financial inability.

item.title: C6 Fest reúne Eduardo Leite, Giulia Be e Fernanda Paes Leme em Săo Paulo
item.description: The C6 Fest, held in São Paulo from May 21 to 24, brought together artists, influencers, and businesspeople, including Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite and his husband, physician Thalis Bolzan. Also in attendance were lawyer John Conor Kennedy and his wife, singer Giulia Be, as well as actress Fernanda Paes Leme. The event took place from May 21 to 24, 2026.

item.title: 6x1: Erika Hilton diz que acordo para transição foi "caminho possível"
item.description: Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) praised the transition agreement to reduce the workweek from 44h to 40h as the 'possible path', despite initially advocating for immediate reduction. She emphasized that the deal prevented opposition proposals to extend the workweek to 52h and represents a labor victory. The reduction will be gradual: 42h in the first 60 days after the PEC’s promulgation, reaching 40h within up to one year.

item.title: Sancionada lei que reconhece relevância cultural nacional da Expo Cordeiro (RJ)
item.description: Expo Cordeiro (RJ), first held in 1921, was recognized as a national cultural manifestation by Law 15.417/2026, signed by President Lula. The event, already an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Rio de Janeiro State since 2021, combines agricultural, commercial, industrial, cultural, tourism and social activities, boosting the economy of the Mountain Region.

item.title: Zanin pede vista e suspende julgamento sobre escola cívico-militar em São Paulo
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin requested a suspension (vista) and halted the judgment on the constitutionality of São Paulo's Law 1398/2024, which establishes the Civic-Military School Program. So far, only rapporteur Minister Gilmar Mendes has voted, partially accepting the PSOL and PT's claims by banning military symbols and hymns in extracurricular activities, requiring uniforms and aesthetics to reflect Brazil's cultural and religious diversity — including minorities — and ruling that payments to military police only take effect one year after the ruling's publication, emphasizing that these are civil schools where pedagogical activities must be led by teachers, not military monitors.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro aciona Janones na Justiça por fala sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint at the STF against federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) for slander, defamation, and insult, after he claimed she would soon be named as a beneficiary of money allegedly stolen by the Bolsonaro family from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Her lawyers argue the statement exceeds parliamentary immunity, as Michelle is not under investigation or criminal prosecution in the Master Case or related to Vorcaro’s bank, making the claim a false and harmful imputation.
